newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Oil to cut costs by 35 bln yen by 2001/01.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Oil to cut costs by 35 bln yen by 2001/01.

text.p: Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd said on Friday it plans to cut costs by 35 billion yen by the fiscal 2000/2001 year in a bid to remain competitive in the oil industry.

Mitsubishi Oil said in a statement it plans to cut personnel costs by six billion yen, production costs by nine billion yen, distribution costs by 18 billion yen, and management costs by two billion yen, compared with 1995/96.
"Mitsubishi Oil is still working on its cost-cutting measures, and details will be announced after the plan has been completed," Yoshihiko Izumitani, president of Mitsubishi Oil, told reporters.
Earlier this month, Mitsubishi Oil revised its 1996/97 parent current profits to a loss of 9.50 billion yen from a previous forecast of eight billion yen in profits.
